name: WP Dynamic Tags
tagline: Dynamic content tags as shortcodes that work in any builder: Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi and more.
description: WP Dynamic Tags lets you create reusable, dynamic content snippets ("tags") and insert them anywhere as shortcodes: the block editor, Elementor, Divi, widgets, or any theme template that runs do_shortcode(). It includes a placeholder engine (post, taxonomy, author, site, URL, date, meta, ACF, WooCommerce), formatters, fallback syntax, inline and block-level conditionals, array loops, per-record templates, query and external API data sources, dual storage (post type or custom table) with migration, conflict detection, and import/export in JSON, CSV, XML and SQL.
author: Eshaan Manchanda
